title: The Benedictions
credit_line: Lent by Iris & B. Gerald Cantor Foundation
description: Two winged female figures descend together, their bodies and sweeping wings forming a flowing silhouette. Rodin designed the group to crown an unrealized monument celebrating labor. This bronze was cast in 1955 and scanned during its loan to Portland Art Museum in 2017.
adult_art_context: Creator museum photograph shows two adult female bodies with mature proportions and breasts. Their close pose and nudity are non-graphic; no sexual act is depicted. Allegorical winged spirits, not child cherubs.

artwork_rights: Rodin composition modeled in 1894; historical work. The 1955 posthumous bronze cast is disclosed. The separate 3D scan is licensed CC BY 4.0.
